meta.name: bugcrowd-reporting
meta.description: Bugcrowd-specific reporting tactics complementing report-writing: VRT category search-and-fallback strategy when no exact match exists, manual severity override when VRT defaults underrate impact, severity-request paragraph as first body section, OOS-clause rebuttal templates (rate limiting on auth-flow endpoints, debug-info framing, user-enumeration with sensitive PII, theoretical-issue counter), chained-finding cross-reference patterns, target selection for QA-vs-prod programs, researcher-side hygiene (Bugcrowdninja email alias, account state restoration, friendly-tester posture). Use when filing a Bugcrowd submission, when VRT default seems wrong, when triager closes as OOS or downgrades severity, when chaining linked submissions, or when scope distinguishes production from QA. Pairs with report-writing and triage-validation.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会帮你写 Bugcrowd 漏洞报告：自动选择最准确的 VRT 分类、手动调整严重等级、在报告开头添加严重等级说明段落、提供 OOS 条款反驳模板，以及处理链式漏洞的交叉引用。
howto.when: 当你提交 Bugcrowd 漏洞报告、VRT 默认严重等级不合适、审核员以 OOS 或降级关闭报告、需要链接多个提交，或项目范围区分生产与 QA 环境时触发。

say.text: 帮我写一个 Bugcrowd 报告，关于登录接口缺少速率限制。
say.note: Claude 会按技能流程选择 VRT 并生成报告。

say.text: 这个漏洞的 VRT 默认是 P4，但我觉得应该是 P2，帮我写严重等级说明。
say.note: Claude 会生成严重等级请求段落。

say.text: 审核员说这是 OOS，帮我写一个反驳理由。
say.note: Claude 会选择合适的 OOS 反驳模板。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude helps you write Bugcrowd reports: selects the most accurate VRT category, overrides severity manually, adds a severity-request paragraph as the first body section, provides OOS-clause rebuttal templates, and handles cross-references for chained findings.
howto.when_en: Triggered when filing a Bugcrowd submission, when the VRT default severity seems wrong, when a triager closes as OOS or downgrades severity, when chaining linked submissions, or when the scope distinguishes production from QA.

say_en.text: Write a Bugcrowd report for missing rate limiting on the login endpoint.
say_en.note: Claude selects VRT and generates the report per skill flow.

say_en.text: The VRT defaults to P4 but I think it's P2. Help me write a severity request.
The triager says it's OOS. Help me write a rebuttal.
say_en.note: Claude picks the appropriate OOS rebuttal template.
